subject: UK Addendum staging and fallback choreography
messages:
From: Sara Maddox <sara.maddox@blueharborhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Patrick White <patrick.white@blueharborhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: UK Addendum + evidence staging — timing and fallback

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. We are moving to final internal review on the DPA + UK Addendum. Legal has asked for a few practical items so we can greenlight the amendment and routing TIA: 

- Canonical subprocessor CSV (full list with roles and locations)
- Evidence staging plan for TIA (what files we will provide and when)
- Confirmation of fallback behavior if onshore routing is unavailable (will there be an onshore cache or a routed fallback to a dedicated EU instance?)
- Any impact to retention/escrow logging during the transition window

I've attached the current BlueHarbor_DPA_Signed_v1.pdf so you can see our redlines. Can you share an expected signing window and whether Redwood can commit to an observable handover (logs and WIP manifests) during the cutover? We need to present this to compliance on Monday EOD.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Patrick and I are standing by for a short list of deliverables.

Best,
Sara
Sara Maddox
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Security
BlueHarbor Health

Attachment: BlueHarbor_DPA_Signed_v1.pdf (pdf, 1.2 MB)

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sara Maddox <sara.maddox@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: UK Addendum + evidence staging — timing and fallback

Sara — thanks, and excellent summary. Short answers up front: we can meet your Monday EOD ask if we lock scope today. Full detail below and an attachment with the evidence staging workbook.

Planned deliverables and timing:
- Subprocessor CSV: I will send the canonical CSV by EOD today (includes hostnames, countries, and access purpose).
- Evidence staging workbook: attached (evidence-staging-workbook.xlsx). Workbook lists items we can provide: SOC2 report snapshot, subprocessor attestations, routing maps, and sample manifest logs. Delivery: preliminary bundle by 2027-05-10 17:00 UTC; final bundle after sign-off.
- Fallback behavior: primary approach will be onshore routing to EU-dedicated instances pinned by the UK Addendum rules. If capacity or region failure occurs, automatic fallback policy is: 1) attempt EU-dedicated burst pool; 2) failover to nearest regional dedicated pool with strict logging (escrow logging enabled); 3) last-resort option is returning an HTTP 503 with structured reason and suggested retry. Jonas — can you confirm the mechanics and whether we should include a temporary onshore cache for session continuity?
- Retention/escrow logging: we will enable transient escrow logs for the handover window (48 hours pre/post cutover) and provide a redacted sample for compliance review.

Doc signing window: Legal can sign a DocuSign envelope if we confirm the dataflow manifest and subprocessor CSV today. Proposed signing window: 2027-05-10 09:00–17:00 UTC.

Next steps (short):
1) I send subprocessor CSV (EOD)
2) Jonas confirms fallback mechanics and attachment of routing matrix (ASAP)
3) We produce preliminary evidence bundle 2027-05-10 17:00 UTC
4) BlueHarbor signs DocuSign envelope once bundle is visible

If that works I'll schedule a 30m alignment call at 10:00 UTC tomorrow to walk the workbook with your compliance/legal team.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Privacy & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence-staging-workbook.xlsx (xlsx, 320 KB)

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sara Maddox <sara.maddox@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: UK Addendum + evidence staging — timing and fallback

On Sun, May 9, 2027 at 11:08 AM laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jonas — can you confirm the mechanics and whether we should include a temporary onshore cache for session continuity?

Quick technical note and confirmation:
- Routing matrix: attached (routing-matrix.csv) — lists model variants, region pinning, and the priority order for failover. Primary pin: EU-dedicated pool (eu-west-1); burst fallback: eu-central-2 dedicated.
- Onshore cache: we can enable a short-lived prefix KV cache that keeps session context for up to 30 minutes onshore. This is inexpensive and will mitigate user-visible failures during brief routing churn. It requires explicit consent in the Addendum (cached token/key handling) — Laura/Kimberly please confirm wording.
- Escrow logging: for handover we will produce a redacted log bundle (request id, timestamp, route decision, model id). Retention: we can hold the handover bundle for 30 days in a secure bucket and provide a signed manifest.
- DPIA trigger: The TIA scope here is limited to routing and processor list changes; BlueHarbor should not need a full DPIA update, but a short TIA appendix is recommended to document the fallback behavior and KV caching.

Attachments included: routing-matrix.csv, kv-fallback-diagram.png

I can join the 10:00 UTC call and walk the matrix.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Staff Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: routing-matrix.csv (csv, 45 KB); kv-fallback-diagram.png (png, 220 KB)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sara Maddox <sara.maddox@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: UK Addendum + evidence staging — timing and fallback

Sara — thanks for the patience and great questions. Confirming the checklist we referenced on the call and next actions so your compliance team has a single note: 

1) Subprocessor CSV: sent (see evidence-staging-workbook tab 2) — includes subprocessors, countries, subprocessor roles.
2) Evidence bundle: preliminary bundle available in the shared drive link in HubSpot by 17:00 UTC on 2027-05-10.
3) Routing & fallback: Jonas has provided the routing matrix and KV caching option. We will add a short TIA appendix that documents the fallback order, KV caching TTL (30m), and escrow log retention (30 days).
4) Signing window: DocuSign envelope opened — please sign during the proposed window. Link below.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/transaction/12345abcdef
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/blueharbor/rec-12345

Once signed, procurement (BlueHarbor) and our SRE team will schedule the handover. We will provide the redacted log bundle within 48 hours of the cutover and retain the handover manifest for 30 days.

If anything is missing from your side that would block sign-off, call that out here and we will prioritize. Otherwise we'll proceed with the 2027-05-10 signing cadence.

Thanks — Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Compliance (Redwood Inference)

Attachment: none
